task.subject: fix(context): coalesce adjacent same-role msgs after compaction (anthropic-compat 400 guard) + drop dead _PRUNED

winning_diff:
--- a/nautilus_v5/commons/context/compactor.py
+++ b/nautilus_v5/commons/context/compactor.py
@@ -170,9 +170,15 @@ async def compact_messages(
     out = list(messages[:head_end])
     if summary:
         out.append({"role": "user", "content": f"{_SUMMARY_PREFIX}\n{summary}"})
     out.extend(messages[tail_start:])
     out = _sanitize_tool_pairs(out)
+
+    # Avoid consecutive same-role messages (e.g. summary user msg directly
+    # followed by another user msg from the tail). Coalesce by merging content
+    # of adjacent same-role messages — they all become a single user msg.
+    coalesced: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for m in out:
+        if coalesced and coalesced[-1].get("role") == m.get("role"):
+            coalesced[-1]["content"] = (coalesced[-1].get("content") or "") + "\n\n" + (m.get("content") or "")
+        else:
+            coalesced.append(dict(m))
+    out = coalesced
+
     return out, (summary or None)
